scenes.title: Buying one? Check these 5 things first.
Run the VIN first.
scenes.body: 2.7 intake valves (24V-635), rear shock reservoirs (25V-025) and more.

scenes.title: Look hard at the roof.
scenes.body: Crazing or delamination on molded-in-color tops means it needs replacing.

scenes.title: Ask about the engine test.
scenes.body: 2021–22 trucks need proof of the intake-valve test or a new engine.

scenes.title: Check the reservoirs.
scenes.body: Badlands and Sasquatch Bilsteins built 9/2020–7/2024 can corrode loose.

scenes.title: Drive every gear.
scenes.body: 2021–23 seven-speeds can scrape in neutral, first or second.
